name: Nav — wordmark, links, and scroll-triggered background appear

planSteps.description: The fixed nav bar shows the wordmark 'G47' at the top-left
The nav bar shows exactly three links with the text 'The Craft', 'Collection', and 'Inquire'
The nav bar now has a visible background/border (its computed background-color is no longer fully transparent, or it has a bottom border), compared to fully transparent at the top of the page
Click the 'Collection' link in the nav bar
The page scrolls to and the viewport shows a section containing the heading text 'Six pieces. No repeats.'
